item.title: Why Draymond Green suggested he come off the Warriors' bench, and why Steve Kerr said no
item.description: The Warriors' Draymond Green, center, yells after scoring between Trail Blazers forward Deni Avdija, left, and center Donovan Clingan on Friday. (Craig Mitchelldyer/Associated Press) PORTLAND, Ore. - This, last week, came one of the few times that coach Steve Kerr would ever shut Draymond Green 's foresight down. They talked on the road, as they do, because things were going wrong. Losing. Losing because of bad process. And so the 36-year-old Green tried to jump ahead, to anticipate, the greatest skill in what Kerr firmly believes is a first-ballot Hall of Fame career. Green told Kerr he'd come off the Golden State Warriors bench, if needed. Just like that. No hemming and hawing. For a man whose entire basketball existence and greatness and controversy has been carved from his own razor-sharp pride, this was a rather remarkable admission of mortality. Why? Why volunteer this? "Because," Green told the Chronicle Friday night, after the Warriors' 116-94 loss to Portland. He pondered. Five seconds passed, as he computed. He settled on the simplest of explanations. "S- wasn't working," Green continued. "So, something's not working, you gotta change something. As a guy who's been here for 15 years and has done what I've done - it's not easy for a coach to be like, ‘All right, I'm gonna do that.' So my mindset is, ‘If that's the case, and it's not easy for you, how about I make it easy for you?'" Kerr, of course, said no. He needed Green to set the tone defensively, in Stephen Curry 's continued absence. Kerr was vindicated in two subsequent wins, as Green locked up Boston Celtics star Jayson Tatum last Sunday and dished out 11 assists against the Sacramento Kings on Wednesday. Green was challenged, again, on Friday, as the Trail Blazers hardly bothered to guard Green in yet another factor that clogged up Golden State's offense in a brutal start. This will only continue to be a wider topic of discussion beyond Golden State's walls - prudent enough that it blossomed inside Green's own supercomputer of a brain - as long as the Warriors struggle offensively in any Curry absence. Green is still excellent defensively and a core facilitator, but is averaging just 3.7 points per game (his lowest figure since his rookie year) on 38.3% shooting from the field. That is certainly acceptable when Curry's gravity helps Green create for the other three on the floor, but often becomes a vortex when Curry's off of it. The Warriors' net rating in lineups with Green and without Curry is -23.4 this season, according to Databallr; albeit a smaller sample size, that would easily stand as the worst mark in any season of the pair's 15-year partnership. If Kerr relents, and turns to Green off the bench before Curry's (now-creeping) return, it'll be met with acceptance. "You just see so many times, people let s- linger, and then you end up on the wrong side of things," Green told the Chronicle. "You know? And it's like - that's not how you win in this league. … So I just wante

item.title: New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani turns to Boston Celtics star Jayson Tatum for Achilles hope
item.description: The NBA has been beset by a rash of Achilles tendon injuries, perhaps none more high-profile than star Boston Celtics forward Jayson Tatum's, sustained in the 2025 NBA Eastern Conference Semifinals second round series vs. the New York Knicks . And the St. Louis native has been putting in work behind the scenes using his own experience to help his peers in the league navigate such a consequential injury, his own recovery serving as a model for them to follow. So with all that in mind, that the Mayor of New York City, popular rising populist star Zohran Mamdani invoked the Celtics star when working his way back to health after his own Achilles tear, suffered in a recent pickup soccer game Mamdani was evidently not properly prepared for the rigors of. Ahead of his Achilles tendon surgery on Friday (Nov. 27), Mamdani reassured himself as much as the assembled media with regard to the procedure while looking to the Celtics star as an example of what could be for his damaged appendage. "I keep telling myself, Jayson Tatum did it, anything is possible," said the New York mayor, perhaps sneaking a paraphrased Kevin Garnett quote for good measure. "I'm scared, it's my first surgery," he admitted. ""I'll be down from 9 a.m. to about 2 p.m. ... "'m going to be laid out for probably a couple days.." With a return to action that brief, it might be Mamdani future NBA players turn to when in need of Achilles tendon injury guidance. Listen to "Airing Boston Celtics grievances, and feats of strength to fix them" on Spreaker. item.title: Russell beats champion Antonelli to Qatar pole
item.description: George Russell took his first pole since the Azerbaijan Grand Prix in September [Getty Images] George Russell led Kimi Antonelli to a one-two as Mercedes dominated qualifying at the Qatar Grand Prix. Russell set two laps quick enough for pole and headed the new world champion by 0.128 seconds. Lando Norris in the McLaren was third, but 0.480secs off the pace, and 0.07secs ahead of team-mate Oscar Piastri. And on the two-by-two grid among the top six, there was a surprise at Red Bull as Isack Hadjar edged four-time champion Max Verstappen for fifth by 0.041secs. Ferrari were a lowly seventh and ninth, Charles Leclerc ahead of Lewis Hamilton, who was also beaten by Racing Bulls' Arvid Lindblad. It was Mercedes' first one-two in qualifying since the Canadian Grand Prix in June. But despite their achievement, there was some tension at Mercedes as Antonelli complained about being sent out at the head of the queue on the final laps. "We need to review with the team," Antonelli said, after paying tribute to Russell for doing a "great job", "because that last run I wanted to go at the back but they sent me first." Russell, though, was serene and unconcerned, at least after qualifying. "The car has been brilliant this weekend, a joy to drive but all sessions I was behind Kimi," the Briton said. "But come qualifying I had a really good feeling." Explaining why Mercedes were so far ahead this weekend, Russell said: "Since we brought the upgrade in Malaysia this is the first real high-speed circuit. We've just been refining the set-up and we have always been quick here." McLaren had not looked like being the next best team but Norris ended up beating the fastest Red Bull by 0.116secs - albeit that the fastest Red Bull was not driven by the usual driver. "Certainly the best position we could get out of it today," Norris said. "The fact we were P3 and P4 as a team is all we can ask for. A good day for us. "P3 would be a win for us tomorrow. The Mercedes have been 0.4, 0.5, 0.6secs faster every lap this weekend. We will try and get past them and get in the middle of them but we're kind of not in their race." Ferrari's lack of pace was the most startling, though - Leclerc was a massive 1.260secs off pole. But at least the Ferrari drivers are not starting alongside each other for the first race since they collided in Las Vegas last weekend. Leclerc said he believed the problem stemmed from the smooth asphalt at Losail. "We are very, very far from the guys in front," he said. "I will take that as an opportunity for the team to try and understand because clearly there is something not working with this type of track. "People might wonder because it's not a very specific track layout but it is a definitely a very specific Tarmac, being very smooth and there are quite a few things that tell us the problem might come from that. "There is no quick fix to that but it is hopefully something we can learn from and hopefully have a solution going in the future." Top 10 1. G

item.title: Brentford aim for 'special things' after ending 89-year Old Trafford wait
item.description: Keith Andrews had never been a first-team manager prior to his appointment at Brentford [Getty Images] "Slightly surreal." That is how Brentford manager Keith Andrews summed up the club's first win at Manchester United in 89 years. And the Bees ended their near nine-decade wait for a victory at Old Trafford in some style - thrashing Mauricio Pochettino's strugglers 4-0 on Saturday. Brentford's last win at United before this weekend was in February 1937 - the longest any side has gone between victories against the Red Devils, surpassing Bristol City's 69-year wait between 1909 and 1978. Granted, Brentford had only played eight games on United's turf since then, given the clubs' contrasting fortunes. But the emphatic way in which they ended that streak is surely cause for celebration for a club who just 12 years ago were competing in League One. "Slightly surreal if I am honest," Andrews told BBC Match of the Day. "We have been keen to enjoy the journey. We want to be really ambitious but [with a] level of humility. I think we can achieve special things because I think it is a special group." Brentford have cemented their status as an established Premier League club but "special things" suggests Andrews sees his side going even further. After a second consecutive 4-0 win, having thumped Everton by the same score on Monday, the Bees are fifth in the league and with European football in their sights. Andrews surpassing expectation Andrews' appointment at Brentford in 2025 divided opinion after the departure of Thomas Frank, who had rightly earned the adoration of the fans having led them to the top flight. While some fans trusted the judgement of the board, others suggested hiring someone who had never been a first-team manager before showed a lack of ambition. There can now be little debate around Andrews' position. The Irishman was handed a new contract in February - just eight months into the job - and after finishing 10th last season, he has his sights set on more this campaign. "I haven't been doing this for very long, but it has been a special week," the 46-year-old told Sky Sports after the win at Old Trafford. "I thought we were well worthy of getting the three points. We could have been more clinical and that was the message at half-time. "Could we take the handbrake off more? Could we go for it? I fancy us all the time when we're in those areas. "Twelve games in and we're in a good groove. We feel we do a lot of things right." The former midfielder's strategy to go for more rather than defend their 2-0 half-time lead speaks volumes for how he views the potential in his side - and it ultimately paid off as they further punished United's frailties. When asked about making history at United, Andrews referenced legendary Bees boss Harry Curtis - Brentford's longest-serving and most successful manager to date. "First one in the Premier League and first win since Harry Curtis was manager," he said. "They were special days for Brentford going back

item.title: Atletico Madrid player ratings vs Elche: Julian Alvarez and Alejandro Grimaldo inspire narrow victory
item.description: Elche CF v Atletico de Madrid - LaLiga EA Sports 2026/27 - Getty Images Sport Atletico Madrid made it three wins in a row with a nervy 3-2 victory at the Estadio Manuel Martinez Valero, where a blistering first-half display was followed by an uncomfortable evening protecting their lead against relegation-threatened Elche. The result keeps Diego Simeone's side third in La Liga on 31 points. Simeone's men could hardly have started faster. Alejandro Grimaldo won a penalty when Federico Redondo brought him down and converted it in the fifth minute, and Lee Kang-in doubled the lead just two minutes later. Martim Neto pulled one back for the hosts in the 26th minute, but Julian Alvarez restored the two-goal cushion before the break, converting a pass from Alex Baena. The second half was a different story. Buba Sangare's long-range strike three minutes after the restart gave Elche belief, and the hosts had 55 per cent of the ball after the interval as Atletico failed to land a single shot on target. Jonathan David missed the visitors' best chance in the 58th minute, while Jan Oblak had to deny Lucas Cepeda and Grady Diangana before Atletico saw the game out. Here, GOAL rates Atletico Madrid's players from the Estadio Manuel Martinez Valero... Goalkeeper & Defence Jan Oblak (6/10): Beaten by Neto's finish from the left of the box and Sangare's strike from distance, with little chance on either. Made two saves after the break, from Cepeda in the 68th minute and Diangana in the 81st, to protect the lead. Marcos Llorente (7/10): Tidy at right-back, misplacing just three passes all evening and winning every ground duel he contested. Set up Alvarez for a late shot that was blocked and was booked in stoppage time as the game grew scrappy. Marc Pubill (6/10): Booked in the 43rd minute for a foul on Fer Nino, but kept things simple afterwards, making three interceptions and winning both of his aerial duels. David Hancko (7/10): Composed on the ball and did his part when Elche pushed in the second half, with three clearances and a block. Was rarely exposed. Alejandro Grimaldo (8/10): Won the penalty himself and calmly converted it to set Atletico on their way. Busy at both ends, he crossed for David's big chance in the 58th minute and made four tackles, before picking up a booking for a foul on Josan in the 85th minute. Midfield Giuliano Simeone (7/10): Tireless on the right, putting in a real shift defensively with three clearances while still finding time to set up Alvarez for a chance just before half-time. Replaced by Robin Le Normand with five minutes left. Pablo Barrios (7/10): Energetic in the middle, winning the ball back six times and making three interceptions. Tried his luck from range in the 12th minute but sent his effort over, and made way for Johnny Cardoso in the 70th minute. Morten Hjulmand (7/10): Neat and dependable at the base of midfield, completing 37 of his 39 passes and winning all four of his ground duels. Replaced by Koke in the 56th min

item.title: ‘Maybe This Isn’t Working Out’: Noah Gragson Put on Notice Ahead of 2027 NASCAR Season
item.description: DAYTONA BEACH, FLORIDA - NOVEMBER 11: Noah Gragson, driver of the #4 Space Force Ford Mustang Dark Horse R, looks on during qualifying prior to the inaugural Ford Proud to Honor Veterans Day Classic at Daytona International Speedway on November 11, 2026 in Daytona Beach, Florida. (Photo by James Gilbert/Getty Images) Getty Noah Gragson has a contract for the 2027 NASCAR Cup Series season. What happens beyond that could largely depend on what he does over the next 36 points-paying races. Front Row Motorsports extended Gragson’s contract this past summer, giving the 28-year-old another season behind the wheel of the No. 4 Ford. But with the 2026 campaign officially in the books, the organization’s leadership is making its expectations for next year abundantly clear. During a recent appearance on SiriusXM NASCAR Radio, Front Row Motorsports general manager Jerry Freeze delivered a particularly candid assessment of Gragson’s performance and long-term prospects with the organization. “So we do have some continuity with him, and I think it’s time to put up the numbers, or maybe this isn’t working out,” Freeze said. “And I think he feels that way, and we certainly feel that way.” For Gragson, who has spent much of his Cup Series career bouncing between organizations, the upcoming season represents an opportunity to establish some long-term job security. But he’s going to have to earn it. View this post on Instagram Front Row Motorsports Wants More From Noah Gragson in 2027 Gragson enters his third season with Front Row Motorsports having yet to replicate the success he enjoyed in NASCAR’s lower national series. The good news for Gragson is that Freeze still believes in his ability. The general manager pointed to his previous success with JR Motorsports and Kyle Busch Motorsports, as well as encouraging stretches of his Cup Series career, including his performance in the 2026 season finale at Homestead-Miami Speedway. The problem has been putting those performances together consistently. “I feel like the last part of the year, it looked like it was going in the right direction to me,” Freeze said. “Even if you just look at where we’re at in the points, it’s our lowest-performing car, however many hundred and some points behind the other cars.” With teammates Todd Gilliland and Zane Smith providing an internal benchmark, Front Row Motorsports has a fairly straightforward way of measuring the No. 4 team’s progress next season. Freeze did, however, acknowledge that Gragson hasn’t exactly enjoyed the most stable introduction to Cup Series racing. His first full-time opportunity with Legacy Motor Club in 2023 ended prematurely. He subsequently joined Stewart-Haas Racing in 2024, only for the organization to cease operations at the conclusion of the season. When Gragson arrived at Front Row Motorsports in 2025, the organization was expanding to three full-time Cup Series entries, meaning he was joining a program that was essentially being built from the ground

item.title: ‘Nigerians mocked me but they understand now’ – Patience Jonathan on Chibok girls
item.description: By Enitan Abdultawab Former First Lady, Dame Patience Jonathan, has revisited the controversy surrounding her emotional reaction to the abduction of schoolgirls from Chibok, Borno State, in 2014, saying Nigerians who mocked her at the time are only now beginning to understand the pain she experienced. Jonathan said the incident remained deeply painful to her because she regarded the abducted girls as her own children. She recalled breaking down in tears when she learnt of their abduction and said the memory still affected her more than a decade later. The former First Lady spoke during an interview with the Nigerian Television Authority on Saturday, where she expressed disappointment over the public ridicule she faced following her emotional response to the tragedy. “I remember 2014. I broke down. I am still feeling it as I talk to you. They are my children. But people started laughing and mocking me. I felt bad. People laughing at me have no empathy. It is today they are realising what happened to me at that time. It still pains me,” she said. Her remarks revisit one of the most controversial moments of her time as First Lady, when she was criticised and widely mocked after breaking down during a meeting with parents and other stakeholders over the abduction. On the night of April 14, 2014, Boko Haram insurgents abducted 276 schoolgirls from Government Girls Secondary School in Chibok, Borno State. The incident triggered international outrage and the #BringBackOurGirls campaign, drawing attention to the security crisis in Nigeria’s North-East. Jonathan’s emotional reaction became a subject of public discussion, with some Nigerians questioning her response to the tragedy. However, in her latest comments, she said those who laughed at her lacked empathy and had failed to appreciate what she was going through at the time. The post ‘Nigerians mocked me but they understand now’ – Patience Jonathan on Chibok girls appeared first on Vanguard News .

item.title: Adebule ​‌‍‍‍‍⁠⁠‍⁠​⁠⁠​​​⁠‌​for burial Sunday as Lagos APC suspends campaign activities
item.description: The remains of Sen. Idiat Adebule, former deputy governor of Lagos State, will be buried on Sunday, Nov. 29, at Ebony Vaults and Gardens, Ikoyi, Lagos. The burial ceremony is scheduled for 3 p.m., according to a statement issued on Saturday by Mr. Seye Oladejo, All Progressives Congress (APC) spokesman in Lagos. The News Agency of Nigeria (NAN) reports that Adebule, who until her death was representing Lagos West Senatorial District in the National Assembly, died on Saturday at 56. Oladejo said the party called on its leaders, elected representatives, stakeholders, members, and supporters to attend the burial and pay their last respects to the deceased senator. He described Adebule, who represented Lagos West Senatorial District, as a political leader, educationist, and distinguished public servant whose sudden death had plunged the party into deep mourning. “Her years of service, commitment to the progressive ideals of the APC and contributions to the political and developmental advancement of Lagos State will remain indelible,” he said. Oladejo said the senator’s death represented a painful and irreplaceable loss to the party and the entire Lagos political family. Meanwhile, the Director-General of the Lagos State APC PBAT/KOH Campaign Council, Sen. Musiliu Obanikoro, has announced the suspension of all campaign activities of the council until further notice. According to Oladejo, the decision was taken as the party mourned the late senator and reflected the profound grief within its ranks. He said the suspension was necessary to accord the deceased the honor, dignity, and solemnity befitting her stature and contributions to public service. “The Lagos APC leadership urges all campaign structures, directorates, committees, supporters, and stakeholders to respect this directive as we collectively mourn this painful loss and stand in solidarity with her family,” he said. Oladejo said the party also extended its condolences to Adebule’s immediate family, political associates, constituents, and the entire Lagos West Senatorial District. He prayed that Almighty Allah would grant her soul eternal rest and give those she left behind the strength to bear the loss. “Adieu, Distinguished Sen. Idiat Adebule. Your service will not be forgotten,” he said. (NAN) The post Adebule ​‌‍‍‍‍⁠⁠‍⁠​⁠⁠​​​⁠‌​for burial Sunday as Lagos APC suspends campaign activities appeared first on Vanguard News .

item.title: Manzambi Gets 8.5, Alysson With 7.5 | Aston Villa Players Rated In Entertaining Draw Vs Ipswich Town
item.description: Manzambi Gets 8.5, Alysson With 7.5 | Aston Villa Players Rated In Entertaining Draw Vs Ipswich Town Aston Villa clashed heads with Ipswich Town at Portman Road earlier this evening as they hoped to earn a good result on the road in the Premier League. The Villans made a decent start to the game and took the lead in the 16th minute when Alysson found the back of the net. Emersonn equalised for the home team just a couple of minutes later. However, Joao Gomes restored Aston Villa’s lead in the 27th minute. Unai Emery’s men went into the half-time break 2-1 up on the scoreline. Leif Davis scored the leveller for Ipswich in the 56th minute as the Villans had to settle for an entertaining 2-2 draw away from home. Let’s take a look at how each Aston Villa player fared during the clash against Ipswich Town. He made a few solid saves at the back, but would not be happy after conceding two goals this evening. RB: Taylor Harwood-Bellis – 6/10 Harwood-Bellis failed to keep things solid defensively but made one good chance going forward. CB: Victor Lindelof – 7/10 He made a lot of crucial clearances inside his half and was a strong presence in the air. CB: Pau Torres – 7/10 Torres cleared the danger when he could and was a threat going forward. He has an assist to show for his efforts. item.title: Steven Gerrard On The Massive Improvement From Liverpool Star
item.description: Steven Gerrard On The Massive Improvement From Liverpool Star Steven Gerrard Identifies Key Figures Behind Florian Wirtz’s Liverpool Revival There is something increasingly familiar about the way Florian Wirtz is beginning to dictate football matches for Liverpool. His movements appear more instinctive, his decisions more assured and his influence on those around him considerably greater. Steven Gerrard believes there are several reasons for that transformation. Wirtz has scored six goals in his last five appearances for club and country, including a goal and an assist in Liverpool’s emphatic 4-0 victory over Manchester United. Ahead of Sunday’s Merseyside derby, Liverpool are pursuing a fourth successive victory under Andoni Iraola. Gerrard Explains Wirtz Transformation Speaking to BBC Radio 5 Live, Gerrard discussed the psychological burden of Wirtz’s £116m transfer from Bayer Leverkusen. “I think he’s going to be very important, obviously the club have spent a lot of money and they believe he is the man that can bring them a lot of success going forward,” Gerrard said. “I’ve watched this kid very closely from the moment he arrived and I felt like when he arrived you could sort of see the heavy transfer fee on his shoulders. [He got] a bit of criticism and you thought you could see him playing with a lack of belief, a little bit, a little bit confidence. “We’ve played the game long enough and we know if you are the No.10, it’s important you play with confidence and freedom and you need to be the go-to person to make this team tick and you need to make the difference in the final third.” Klopp and Iraola Influence Liverpool Playmaker Gerrard believes working with Jurgen Klopp internationally has helped restore Wirtz’s confidence, drawing upon his own experiences with Liverpool’s former manager. Photo: IMAGO “I think he was really wearing that in a Liverpool shirt and there’s no doubt that spending a couple of blocks on [international] fixtures with [Jurgen Klopp], that would help anyone on the planet. “Let me tell you right now, I went back during an MLS season and I trained with Jurgen Klopp and I felt like I was [Liverpool] captain again. He has that charisma, he has that love where he just makes you feel that extra bit taller. “But what I would say is I think it’s a bit disrespectful to think it is just because of Jurgen because there is no doubt about it – I’ve seen the difference myself. Under Iraola, he is given more freedom, more licence to take risks, to be the difference-maker. “So I think it’s a been a combination of Iraola, Klopp, Isak getting back to 100% fit because [Wirtz] needs runners. Munoz runs to break the backline, Gakpo has been in good form.” Liverpool System Unlocking Wirtz Potential Gerrard, who made 710 appearances for Liverpool, understands the importance of surrounding a creative midfielder with intelligent attacking movement. “I played a couple of years as a No.10. The only reason I looked effective as a No.10 was bec

item.description: MIAMI GARDENS, FLORIDA - SEPTEMBER 08: General view outside of the stadium prior to a game between the Miami Dolphins and the Jacksonville Jaguars at Hard Rock Stadium on September 08, 2024 in Miami Gardens, Florida. Despite the record, the Dolphins have been a gritty team under first-year head coach Jeff Hafley. In fact, four of their losses this season have come from one-score games. Yet, it’s abundantly clear that the team needs to add talent to its roster to be competitive in the ever-tough AFC. Hafley and co. have hit on players in their first draft, like Jacob Rodriguez, Kaydn Proctor, and Chris Johnson. Their biggest position of need is quarterback. The team signed Malik Willis this offseason because of the Hafley-Willis Green Bay Packers tie, but the team needs a long-term answer at quarterback. He’s not a finished product, which stands to reason given that he was a punter for his high school team, but the Dolphins are a terrific landing spot as Malik Willis will allow him to not be rushed to start.” Prior to his time with Oklahoma State, Mestemaker spent his first two college seasons with North Texas. There, he completed 68.6% of passes for 4,841 passing yards, 36 touchdowns, and 11 interceptions. Additionally, he rushed for 176 yards and six touchdowns. item.title: Bayern held after Kimmich's misbehaviour, Paderborn demolish Schalke
item.description: Bayern Munich's Joshua Kimmich (3rd L) receives a red card during the German Bundesliga soccer match between Hamburger SV and Bayern Munich at Volksparkstadion. (is associated with: «Bayern held after Kimmich's misbehaviour, Paderborn demolish Schalke») Marcus Brandt/dpa Ten-man Bayern Munich were held to a goalless draw at Hamburg, while Paderborn thrashed Schalke 8-1 in the clash between the two promoted sides on Saturday. The Bavarians will be relieved to snatch at least a point after captain Joshua Kimmich was sent off in the 44th minute for pulling Alexander Røssing-Lelesiit's hair after a confrontation with the Hamburg striker off the ball. "I don't think you could tell that we were a man down in the second half. And when you can say that, you can certainly be proud of the performance. We're never satisfied when we don't win. But we can genuinely be proud of the performance we put in, playing away from home with 10 men," defender Jonathan Tah said. Cologne, meanwhile, had a much better day and also claimed a big win with Marius Bülter scoring a hat-trick and Said El Mala a brace in the 5-0 victory against Elversberg. "Marius is a player who works hard every day and, with his experience, is an important mentor for us and the lads. These successes can definitely be a turning point," Cologne coach René Wagner said. Elsewhere, coach Urs Fischer saw his Mainz team score two late goals to claim a 2-1 comeback win against his former club Union Berlin. In the late game, VfB Stuttgart took the lead twice but had to settle for a point in a 2-2 draw with Eintracht Frankfurt. Kimmich's transgression caps tough week for Bayern Bayern remain second in the standings, now one point behind leaders Borussia Dortmund, who face Bayer Leverkusen on Sunday. The German giants also need to watch out for Freiburg and RB Leipzig, who face each other also on Sunday. Both of them can leapfrog Bayern in the standings with a win. After losing the Bundesliga lead to Dortmund last weekend, the Bavarians had a difficult week, which included a 2-1 defeat to Lille in the Champions League. The sporting matters, however, have been overshadowed by the public remarks from Bayern officials about the health condition of midfielder Jamal Musiala, who revealed earlier this year that he suffers from absence seizures. Bayern supervisory board members Uli Hoeness and Karl-Heinz Rummenigge raised the prospect of the midfielder taking a pay cut because of his health problems. The two also publicly questioned whether Musiala, one of Bayern's top earners with a contract running until 2030, could return to his previous level of performance. On Friday, Musiala became the latest addition to Bayern's long injury list due to muscular issues in his right hamstring. The list also include top striker Harry Kane, who will be sidelined for months, and forward Michael Olise. Bayern will be without Kimmich for the next league game against Paderborn due to the red card, and also might be without Konrad

item.title: NHL rumors: Ducks remain in Simon Edvinsson sweepstakes as deadline looms
item.description: Kiyoshi Mio-Imagn Images NHL rumors: Ducks remain in Simon Edvinsson sweepstakes as deadline looms appeared first on ClutchPoints . Add ClutchPoints as a Preferred Source by clicking here . Time is running out for Simon Edvinsson . If the Detroit Red Wings defenseman doesn’t sign a contract by 5 p.m. ET Dec. 1, he’ll be ineligible to play in the NHL for the remainder of the 2026-27 season. That’s a worst-case scenario for all involved, and Red Wings interim general manager Shawn Horcoff faces pressure to sign the restricted free agent or complete a trade that allows Edvinsson to reach a deal with another club before the deadline. Multiple teams have reportedly been circling around the blueliner, including the Anaheim Ducks , who remain in the hunt , as The Fourth Period’s David Pagnotta reported earlier this week. Watch sports LIVE with fuboTV (free trial) “Very intrigued by Anaheim,” the hockey insider said in the latest edition of DFO Insider alongside Jeff Marek. “They’ve got the pieces, I would imagine, to make this work – they would have to make the money work. So similar to Montreal’s trade with Detroit for Larkin, including (Kirby) Dach and (Sam) Montembeault in order to be cap compliant and make everything financially fit, you’d look at Anaheim and you look at certain pieces. “Starting to hear more of Pavel Mintyukov’s name popping up as a possible inclusion into whatever package this could possibly be.” Edvinsson spent time in his native Sweden but has returned to North America and is training and skating in Arizona as he awaits a trade, “which could come over the weekend,” Pagnotta noted. Close to a dozen teams have shown interest in Edvinsson throughout the season, including the Ducks, San Jose Sharks, Nashville Predators, Boston Bruins, Toronto Maple Leafs, St. Louis Blues, Seattle Kraken, Utah Mammoth, Carolina Hurricanes, Edmonton Oilers and Philadelphia Flyers. As with Larkin, Detroit’s asking price is reportedly significant . There were recent reports that Edvinsson declined to sign offer sheets because Detroit could match, and he no longer wants to play for the franchise. The Ducks could offer a package that includes Mintyukov; the 23-year-old carries a $7.2 million cap hit, but Anaheim is tight against the salary cap and would likely need to move another roster player to accommodate Edvinsson’s next contract. Pagnotta reported that Edvinsson’s next deal could carry an average annual value of $10 million to $11 million. With the deadline now roughly 72 hours away, it looks like this situation really will come down to the wire. item.title: Gattuso ‘curious’ to see how Lazio handle fans after boycott suspended
item.description: Gattuso ‘curious’ to see how Lazio handle fans after boycott suspended Gennaro Gattuso admits he is ‘happy’ with Lazio’s mentality after a 2-1 win away to Torino , but now he is ‘curious to see how we handle’ a full Stadio Olimpico when fans suspend their boycott. The Aquile are simply refusing to stop soaring this season, as after 13 rounds they have dropped points only in two draws against Milan and Napoli. Christos Mandas made some big saves at the Stadio Olimpico Grande Torino, but Lazio were clinical with their two Danes on the stroke of half-time, first the Oliver Provstgaard header on a corner, then Gustav Isaksen’s strike. Che Adams kept it tense to the final minutes with his header on a set play, but the Biancocelesti emerged with a 2-1 victory. Gattuso eager to see Lazio fly TURIN, ITALY – NOVEMBER 28: SS Lazio head coach Gennaro Gattuso and Torino FC head coach Ignazio Abate prior the Serie A match between Torino FC and SS Lazio at Stadio Olimpico Grande Torino on November 28, 2026 in Turin, Italy. (Photo by Marco Rosi – SS Lazio/Getty Images) “We don’t lose our shape, no matter the situation,” Gattuso told DAZN Italia. “We were focused from the start today, going three on three, knowing they would bring midfielders into the box and knock the ball down for them. We stayed concentrated, and that is a sign of a strong mentality, so I feel very proud. “It’s true that Torino threatened an equaliser, but we also had lots of scoring opportunities, and the fact the team plays with such vehemence is important. I feel happy today.” Before Lazio, only six teams in the three points for a win era managed to secure 35 points after 13 Serie A rounds. Of those six, five went on to win the Scudetto, the only outlier being Napoli who finished second in 2017/18. TURIN, ITALY – NOVEMBER 28: Gennaro Gattuso, Manager of S.S. Lazio, reacts during the Serie A match between Torino FC and SS Lazio at Stadio Olimpico Grande Torino on November 28, 2026 in Turin, Italy. (Photo by Valerio Pennicino/Getty Images) “It’s all about the mentality, there is great enthusiasm and the team does not back off,” continued Gattuso. “I can only thank the players for the effort they are putting in. They are enjoying themselves, and enthusiasm is strong fuel. If we work like this, we can make mistakes on a technical level, but never the mentality.” There is another reason for Lazio to feel comfortable, as they are not only unbothered by European commitments, but were eliminated from the Coppa Italia in the first round, so rest next week too. After that, the ultras have already said they will suspend their boycott of home fixtures for next weekend when former Lazio coach Maurizio Sarri returns to the Stadio Olimpico on the Atalanta bench. item.title: Thrilling draw in Stuttgart
item.description: Thrilling draw in Stuttgart Ansgar Knauff and Younes Ebnoutalib got the goals as Eintracht twice came from behind to earn a 2-2 draw at VfB Stuttgart. Two fresh faces Head coach Adi Hütter made two changes to his starting line-up for the trip to Stuttgart, with Elias Baum coming in for Keita Kosugi, and Mario Götze replacing Noel Aseko. Chances for Eintracht The two sides initially cancelled each other out, with plenty of intensity in the challenges. After 16 minutes, Jonathan Burkardt attempted an overhead kick inside the penalty area to provide the first real moment of excitement. Two minutes later, Lilian Brassier fired towards the VfB goal from a corner, but his effort was blocked by Maximilian Mittelstädt. Frankfurt grow into the game The Eagles continued to apply pressure and, just before the half-hour mark, birthday boy Farès Chaibi broke into the penalty area but dragged his shot wide of the left-hand post. Prömel puts Stuttgart ahead Frankfurt’s defence had been solid all game but it was undone in the 42 nd minute by Ermedin Demirovic’s pass to Grischa Prömel, who left Noah Atubolu no chance from 11 metres out. Knauff levels In first-half stoppage time, Ansgar Knauff fired towards the VfB goal following a corner. It took a deflection off Deniz Undav, causing the ball to loop beyond the goalkeeper and send the teams in level at 1-1. Jaquez scores, Ebnoutalib equalises Shortly after the restart, Frankfurt’s defence lost track of Luca Jaquez following a cross from Undav, allowing him to head past Atubolu from close range (53’). However, Eintracht responded perfectly to falling behind again. Following a lovely move involving Knauff and Burkardt, Younes Ebnoutalib fired a low shot into the bottom-right corner from 11 metres to make it 2-2 (62’). The match subsequently developed into an end-to-end thriller with chances for both teams. However, neither side was able to add to the scoreline, leaving each with a deserved point.

item.title: From jeers to European dreams - how Farke transformed Leeds
item.description: There is a song Leeds United supporters sing during games about passports and Daniel Farke. It is about dreaming of a return to Europe and is usually heard when the German's side are winning. At a rain-soaked Elland Road on Saturday, fans belted it out time and time again as their side turned on the style to dispose of Coventry City 3-0 and climb to sixth in the Premier League, having sealed a third-straight top-flight win for the first time since 2021. Two goals from Sean Longstaff - after Dominic Calvert-Lewin had opened the scoring - secured the points and maintained Leeds' winning momentum after back-to-back victories over Tottenham and Chelsea. The Whites have not competed in Europe since 2002, but Farke has got supporters believing a return to continental action might not be far away. "They deserve to dream, think big," Farke told BBC Sport about fans' European dreams. "They should feel the joy." However, the Leeds boss insisted he would not be allowing his players to get carried away - despite their impressive form. "We are in our second season after promotion, second season is normally tough. We will stay focused and concentrated," Farke added. 'Phenomenal and relentless' Leeds' transformation over the past 12 months has been nothing short of remarkable. They turned up at Manchester City on 29 November 2025 having lost five of their previous six league games, and lost again 3-2 at Etihad Stadium to remain stuck in the relegation zone. However, Farke changed the shape of the team at half-time - switching to a three-man central defence - and an improved second-half performance in Manchester bought the under-pressure manager some time. Since then Leeds have gone from strength to strength - and return to Etihad Stadium on Wednesday having picked up 56 points from the past 37 games. "Leeds have been phenomenal - they are so aggressive and so difficult to beat," former Leeds keeper Kasper Schmeichel, who watched the Coventry game for BBC Sport, said. "Daniel Farke's side just do the basics really well and have been relentless." Since Farke switched to that three-man central defence, Leeds have reached an FA Cup semi-final, won 13 Premier League games, drawn 17 and lost just seven. In the closing stages against Coventry, Farke's name echoed around Elland Road. "The early days of Farke were functional and he felt like someone who would get us out of the Championship and maybe no further," said Michael Normanton, from the Square Ball Leeds United fan podcast. "But the way it has gone over the last 12 months, I think maybe now there's still a chance of us moving beyond that." 'Leeds is the perfect place for me' Another reason for Leeds' upturn in fortunes has been the form of Calvert-Lewin, who celebrated his new contract by heading the opener against Coventry - his sixth league goal of the season. It was his 20th in 47 Premier League games since the former Everton forward joined Leeds on a free transfer in August 2025. No other English player has

item.title: Tua Tagovailoa’s time with Falcons is over as he agrees to part ways with team
item.description: Brett Davis-Imagn Images Tua Tagovailoa’s time with Falcons is over as he agrees to part ways with team appeared first on ClutchPoints . Add ClutchPoints as a Preferred Source by clicking here . The Atlanta Falcons (3-7) and veteran quarterback Tua Tagovailoa have agreed to part ways , ending his brief tenure with the organization ahead of Sunday’s Week 12 road matchup against the Minnesota Vikings (7-3) at 1 p.m. ET on Fox. ESPN’s Adam Schefter reported the development Saturday afternoon on X, formerly known as Twitter. “Just in: Falcons and QB Tua Tagovailoa have agreed to part ways, per @RapSheet and me.” Watch sports LIVE with fuboTV (free trial) Tagovailoa joined Atlanta during the offseason following his departure from the Miami Dolphins but struggled to find playing time behind second-year starter Michael Penix Jr. The 28-year-old appeared in just two games during his tenure with the Falcons, most recently in their 29-20 Week 7 victory over the San Francisco 49ers, although he did not record any statistics in that contest. His only statistical production came during Atlanta’s 30-23 overtime loss to the Baltimore Ravens in Week 5 , when he completed two of three passes for 34 yards and an interception. Just in: Falcons and QB Tua Tagovailoa have agreed to part ways, per @RapSheet and me. pic.twitter.com/WgpelxKA5L — Adam Schefter (@AdamSchefter) November 28, 2026 Tagovailoa’s departure marks another significant development in his career after spending his first six NFL seasons with Miami, which selected him with the No. 5 overall pick in the 2020 NFL draft. The former Alabama standout earned his first Pro Bowl selection during the 2023 season, when he led the NFL with 4,624 passing yards while throwing 29 touchdowns. Falcons move on from Tua Tagovailoa amid disappointing season Atlanta entered the 2026 campaign with hopes of returning to postseason contention under new head coach Kevin Stefanski. However, the Falcons have struggled to establish consistency through their first 10 games. The organization will now move forward with Penix as its starting quarterback while Tagovailoa faces an uncertain future as he seeks his next opportunity in the NFL. Meanwhile, the Falcons will attempt to snap a three-game losing streak against Minnesota after suffering a 35-13 loss to the Kansas City Chiefs in Week 10. Atlanta faces a difficult challenge against a Vikings team that has won seven of its first 10 games as the Falcons look to secure their fourth victory of the season. item.title: ‘I’ve made huge strides forward’ - Ansgar Knauff reflects on Stuttgart draw
item.description: ‘I’ve made huge strides forward’ - Ansgar Knauff reflects on Stuttgart draw Eintracht Frankfurt twice came from behind to secure a 2-2 draw against Stuttgart on Saturday, with goals from Ansgar Knauff and Younes Ebnoutailib cancelling out efforts from Grischa Prömel and Luca Jaquez. Speaking to Sky after the clash, Man of the Match Knauff was pleased with his individual contribution and the team's overall display, but admitted that the result left him with mixed feelings. “I think I’ve made huge strides forward in the last few weeks,” Knauff told Sky. “I already played well last week against Hoffenheim, and I think I was able to confirm that again today with a solid performance. “And yeah, I’m glad that I think I’ve found my place in the team a little bit now. “I think we played a very good game overall, creating good counterattacking opportunities ,” he explained. The winger also discussed Frankfurt's tactical approach, revealing that the team had deliberately planned to start at full intensity and put Stuttgart under pressure from the opening minutes. “Yeah, definitely. I think that was our plan. We already knew they had played three days ago. We wanted to go full throttle right from the start, put them under pressure. “It worked well for us time and again, especially in the first half." However, while he was pleased with Frankfurt's overall performance, Knauff could not hide his disappointment at the final result. "I'm frustrated in the end that we didn't win ,” he admitted. “But I think we can be very satisfied with today's performance overall.” “Towards the end, I think it was an open game where it could have gone either way,” Knauff concluded.

item.title: Warriors Trade Path to $112 Million ‘Sharpshooter’ Laid Out
item.description: Trey Murphy III #25 of the New Orleans Pelicans Getty Things will change for the Golden State Warriors after December 15. That’s not because Stephen Curry might be back by then (fingers are crossed by the Bay that his return will be sooner), but because the team could find itself ready to make the much-anticipated trade of Kristaps Porzingis then. The Warriors can trade Porzingis now, but because other teams have players who can’t be dealt until the middle of next month, and because teams are still weighing their own futures, the post-December 15 date is the one the organization has its eye on. Unofficially, around the NBA, that is considered the first day of trade season. And Porzingis is one of the most fascinating cases, because he is not going to play this season but his $20 million contract (with only $3 million guaranteed for next year) can be traded as a means for teams seeking to cut payroll, avoid aprons and/or move off an unwanted contract. It’s unlikely that Porzingis will be traded exactly on December 16, but it’s also unlikely the Warriors will wait until the February deadline to move him. Warriors Will Have Options At the San Francisco Chronicle, beat writer Luca Evans had four targets for the Warriors, including Naz Reid, Myles Turner and Daniel Gafford, all big guys who could be useful in replacing Porzingis, but who come with their own flaws. But there has been buzz around the league that the Warriors won’t necessarily go for a center in a move for Porzingis–they could simply go for the best player they can get. And that would likely be Trey Murphy. Evans lays out the package for Murphy–who has been frequently connected to the Dubs–that the Warriors could offer: “Package Porzingis, Moody and draft capital for Murphy, who would have league-wide interest if he’s truly on the trade block and would likely command a significantly higher asking price.” what a night for Trey Murphy III 🤩25 PTS6 STL2 REB pic.twitter.com/g0Bc26m1DO — New Orleans Pelicans (@PelicansNBA) November 28, 2026 Trey Murphy Struggling With Knee Issues That would be an attractive package from the Warriors, who would welcome Murphy’s production, as well as his reasonable contract. Murphy is in the second of a four-year, $112 million deal. Evans notes Murphy is, “a 6-foot-8 sharpshooter who averaged 21.5 points per game last season. While dealing with knee troubles this season, though, Murphy has dropped to 15.1 points per game on a lost Pelicans team.” And he quoted a personnel executive: “Trey is a whole other level of swing, good pairing with Yaxel (Lendeborg) for the future of the team as well, would cost multiple firsts. … If I’m G.S., I would part with picks for Trey.” The countdown is on for the Warriors. item.title: Former Dolphins quarterback Tua Tagovailoa released by Atlanta Falcons
item.description: MIAMI GARDENS, FLORIDA - DECEMBER 21: Tua Tagovailoa #1 of the Miami Dolphins looks on during the second half of the game against the Cincinnati Bengals at Hard Rock Stadium on December 21, 2025 in Miami Gardens, Florida. (Photo by Megan Briggs/Getty Images) | Getty Images On Saturday, it was announced by various media outlets that the Atlanta Falcons released former Miami Dolphins Pro Bowl quarterback Tua Tagovailoa ahead of their Week 12 contest against the Minnesota Vikings. The release comes after Tagovailoa played in just one game for the Falcons this season — Week 7 against the Baltimore Ravens, a game in which Tagovailoa’s overtime interception cost Atlanta the victory. Tagovailoa finishes his Falcons’ career with 2 completions on 3 attempts for 34 yards, zero touchdowns and one interception — good for a 65.3 passer rating. In 78 games played for the Dolphins, the former #5 overall pick in the 2020 NFL Draft completed 1,647 out of 2,421 passes for 18,166 yards, 120 passing touchdowns and 59 interceptions. His 68% completion rate is the best in team history — as is his 96.4 pass rating. All eyes turn towards where Tagovailoa will continue his career — with some already speculating that the Los Angeles Chargers might look to reunite the passer with his former head coach, Chargers’ offensive coordinator Mike McDaniel in Southern California. Los Angeles starting quarterback Justin Herbert is currently dealing with a concussion and has already been ruled out for the Chargers’ Week 12 tilt against the New England Patriots. The Dolphins are in a heated race with Los Angeles and the Tennessee Titans for the first overall selection in the 2027 NFL Draft. Tagovailoa winning games for the Chargers — if the team does in fact sign the quarterback — would be his final positive act for the Dolphins’ organization.

item.title: 'It hasn't impacted selection': George Bailey dismisses Cameron Bancroft's Sandpapergate blacklisting claim
item.description: Australia's chief selector George Bailey has firmly rejected Cameron Bancroft's suggestion that he was overlooked for the Test side because of his comments about the 2018 Sandpapergate scandal, insisting the controversy never influenced selection decisions. Bancroft, one of the three Australian players suspended following the ball-tampering scandal in South Africa in 2018, recently revisited the episode in a lengthy article, claiming he had wondered whether his public comments in 2021 had affected his chances of returning to the Test team. Responding to the allegation at a press conference following Australia's squad announcement for the upcoming home Test series against New Zealand, Bailey said he had personally addressed Bancroft's concerns on multiple occasions. "I can (talk about it), it hasn’t (impacted selection), and I’ve articulated that to Cam on a number of occasions across the years as I think that thought has entered his mind," Bailey told reporters. "But that has never been a discussion from our end." Bancroft was again overlooked for the New Zealand Tests, with Queensland batter Jack Clayton now in the box seat to replace Marnus Labuschagne. The first Test begins in Perth on December 9. Bancroft felt 'the easiest option' was not to select him In his article, Bancroft said he had trusted the selection process for years but could not help wondering whether the unresolved tensions surrounding Sandpapergate had affected his chances, despite his consistent Sheffield Shield performances. "For many years I believed I would be selected because I trusted the selection process," Bancroft wrote. "But I would be lying if I said I had never wondered whether the unresolved tension surrounding these events in South Africa had played a part. Because in spite of having scored the most hundreds of any player in the competition in the last six years, including featuring in the top-three run scorers for over half that period I have never had a look in. "After my “self-explanatory” public statement in 2021, I felt increasingly uncomfortable around some of the people involved. I wondered whether my presence in an Australian dressing room might bring back questions that others wanted to leave behind. "I wondered whether the easiest option was simply not to select me which I believe to be quite unfair in my opinion." Bancroft's comments date back to his 2021 interview, in which he suggested that the Australian bowlers knew sandpaper was being used to tamper with the ball during the 2018 South Africa tour. Pat Cummins, Mitchell Starc, Josh Hazlewood and Nathan Lyon subsequently issued a joint statement strongly denying the assertion. Usman Khawaja later said the bowlers' statement had been issued without consulting everyone who was part of that tour. The episode, Bancroft has indicated, left him feeling isolated. Bailey, however, maintained that the issue had never entered the selection discussion. ‘Focus will be getting back to playing near our best’ Austr

item.title: Sam LaPorta Linked To Dolphins With $72 Million Price Tag
item.description: Credit USA TODAY Network via Reuters Connect The Miami Dolphins are actively tracking Detroit Lions tight end Sam LaPorta as a top target for the 2027 free agency period. Heavy.com reports the team is looking at a massive four-year contract worth $72 million to secure the 24-touchdown producer. That deal breaks down to roughly $18 million per season according to reports. The front office sees this as the right move to fix a key hole in the offense. LaPorta brings immediate value after a strong start to his career. The Lions selected him with the 34th overall pick in the 2023 NFL Draft out of the University of Iowa. His rookie year showed why teams love him, as he caught 86 passes for 889 yards and 10 touchdowns. He earned a trip to the Pro Bowl and landed on the All-Pro Second Team that same season. He also came in third for Offensive Rookie of the Year, trailing C.J. Stroud and Puka Nacua. Why the Price Tag Makes Sense His career totals stand at 229 receptions for 2,625 yards and 24 touchdowns over four years. Some fans might point to a dip in recent numbers, but the context matters. LaPorta has to fight for every single touch against those talented teammates. Even with that competition, he stays among the top pass-catching and blocking tight ends in the league. The Dolphins have the cash to make this happen. After eating a huge dead money hit last offseason when they released Tua Tagovailoa and Tyreek Hill, the team is now flush with cap space. They are projected to have around $102.2 million available for the 2027 offseason. This financial freedom puts them in a great spot to add solid pieces. Instead of chasing a wide receiver, Miami is focusing on a player who can block and catch. Cap Space Opens the Door Many great players will become free agents in 2027, including Puka Nacua and George Pickens. Those names would cost a fortune, but LaPorta offers a specific skill set the Dolphins need right now. The team needs better pass-catchers, and a tight end who can block is rare. A four-year, $72 million deal is high, but it fits the current market for elite talent. The decision comes down to whether the Dolphins want to spend big on a receiver or a tight end. Heavy.com notes that the link to LaPorta is based on salary cap reality and a genuine need for a difference-maker. The front office has to decide if the risk of paying $18 million a year is worth the reward. They have the money, and they have the need. Looking Ahead to 2027 While the team looks toward next year, they must also deal with the present. The Dolphins currently sit at 1-9 heading into their Week 12 game against the New York Jets. Head coach Jeff Hafley has kept the team gritty despite the record. Four of their losses this season came by just one score. The team needs to add talent to be competitive in the tough AFC. They have already hit on players in their first draft under Hafley, such as Jacob Rodriguez and Kadyn Proctor. Adding a star like LaPorta would be the biggest boost the

item.title: Ohio State star WR Jeremiah Smith sets another new record during Michigan matchup
item.description: Joseph Maiorana-Imagn Images. Ohio State star WR Jeremiah Smith sets another new record during Michigan matchup appeared first on ClutchPoints . Add ClutchPoints as a Preferred Source by clicking here . Ohio State Buckeyes wide receiver Jeremiah Smith set the program’s single-season record for touchdown catches Saturday against the Michigan Wolverines. The junior caught a 5-yard pass from quarterback Luke Fahey for his 18th receiving touchdown of the season, breaking the record Terry Glenn set in 1995. Smith’s first catch of the game capped a 13-play, 80-yard drive. The extra point gave the Buckeyes a 14-0 lead with 13:29 left in the second quarter. Smith struck the Heisman pose after the catch. ClutchPoints shared a Big Ten Network clip on X, formerly Twitter, showing Fahey finding Smith in the end zone on first-and-goal. Watch sports LIVE with fuboTV (free trial) Jeremiah Smith HAULS in his 18th touchdown 🙌 He now holds the Ohio State single-season record for most receiving TDs. pic.twitter.com/yUP6dfp02S — ClutchPoints (@ClutchPoints) November 28, 2026 Glenn won the Biletnikoff Award and earned consensus first-team All-America honors in 1995, when he caught 17 touchdown passes. Smith tied that mark last week against the Nebraska Cornhuskers, then moved ahead of Glenn on his first reception in the regular-season finale. That same week, Smith set the Big Ten record with his 18th career 100-yard receiving game. The touchdown also left Smith one shy of the Big Ten single-season record. Michigan’s Desmond Howard caught 19 touchdown passes in 1991, the year he won the Heisman Trophy. Howard famously struck the pose after a 93-yard punt return for a touchdown against the Buckeyes that season. Smith already holds Ohio State’s career records for receptions, receiving yards and receiving touchdowns. He also owns the Big Ten career marks for receiving yards and touchdowns. The catch against Michigan was his 45th career touchdown reception and brought him to 4,045 career receiving yards. Smith entered Saturday with 86 catches for 1,482 yards this season. The Buckeyes lead the Wolverines 21-0 at halftime, with the second half set to kick off in just minutes. The Gamecocks have won their past two visits to Memorial Stadium, despite Clemson’s overall success in the rivalry. Now, South Carolina will attempt to make it three consecutive road victories against the Tigers when the programs meet for the 123rd time. Kickoff is scheduled for 3 p.m. ET on ESPN2. South Carolina Has Found Success in Death Valley South Carolina has enjoyed recent success on Clemson’s home field. The Gamecocks defeated the Tigers in Death Valley in both 2022 and 2024. Those victories stand out in a rivalry Clemson has largely controlled over the past decade. However, the Tigers responded with a 28-14 victory in Columbia last season. As a result, Saturday provides South Carolina with an opportunity to continue its recent road success while reclaiming bragging rights. LaNorris Sellers Presents a Challenge for Clemson South Carolina quarterback LaNorris Sellers remains an important part of the Gamecocks’ offensive approach. His ability to extend plays gives South Carolina opportunities beyond its designed passing and rushing attacks. Additionally, Sellers can create difficult decisions for opposing defenders when plays break down. Clemson will need to contain his mobility while maintaining coverage downfield. Meanwhile, South Carolina must protect the football and establish offensive consistency against the Tigers. The Gamecocks enter Saturday with a 6-5 record after consecutive losses to Arkansas and Georgia. Nevertheless, a rivalry victory would provide a positive conclusion to the regular season. Clemson Faces Its Own Offensive Questions Clemson enters the matchup with a 7-4 record following a 20-10 victory over Duke. Quarterback Trent Pearman started against the Blue Devils after injuries affected Clemson’s quarterback depth. Pearman completed 17 of 27 passes for 164 yards. Additionally, he rushed for 51 yards and a touchdown. The Tigers will look to establish an effective offensive approach against South Carolina. However, protecting the quarterback and limiting negative plays will remain important. Clemson’s defense also has an opportunity to influence the matchup by limiting Sellers’ ability to create explosive plays. Palmetto Bowl Offers More Than Postseason Preparation Both programs have secured bowl eligibility entering Saturday. However, the annual rivalry remains an important part of each team’s season. item.title: PLAYER RATINGS | VfB Stuttgart 2-2 Eintracht Frankfurt – Thrilling Bundesliga ‘Top-Spiel’ ends all square
item.description: PLAYER RATINGS | VfB Stuttgart 2-2 Eintracht Frankfurt – Thrilling Bundesliga ‘Top-Spiel’ ends all square The 2026/27 Bundesliga’s Saturday evening matchday 11 “Top-Spiel” has ended without a winner. Sebastian Hoeneß’ VfB Stuttgart and Adi Hütter’s Eintracht Frankfurt split the difference in a floodlight encounter at the MHP Arena. An eminently entertaining match between the Swabian hosts and their Hessen guests ultimately proved worthy of its billing. A lively start fails to produce goals Neither team shied away from risks in the opening minutes. Deniz Undav – keen to put his early season form woes behind him – pressed forward alongside attacking partners Grischa Prömel and Ermedin Demirovic. The trio occupying the top two VfB attacking axes nevertheless accomplished little beyond getting in each other’s way. At the other end of the pitch, Eintracht too tended to trip over their own feet heading forward. Jonathan Burkardt (16th minute) and Lilian Brassier (18th minute) were finally able to get a pair of quality chances off once the level of play caught up with the energy in the SGE legs. Frankfurt survive red card scare After finally building up some momentum, the Hessian guests looked to be shackled by a Robin Koch red card in the 20th minute. The Eintracht captain appeared to cut down Demirovic when the Stuttgart striker had a clear path to the net. Match official Sascha Stegemann, compelled to take another look at the scene by the VAR team, observed that Koch’s sliding challenge was actually fair. Stegemann withdrew the red shown to Koch and the match continued at a frenetic pace. Clear chances at goal were nonetheless still lacking. An entertaining first half finally gets some goals The two sides threw themselves wholeheartedly into the direct duels and observers were treated to plenty of pacy passing and crunching tackles. Burkardt tested Dennis Seimen with an effort in the 29th minute. One minute later, Noah Atubolu gathered an effort from Maximilian Mittelstädt. Jeff Chabot did well to defuse a Farès Chaïbi shot in the 34th. Just when it appeared as if neither team would be rewarded for their steady efforts, the deserved breakthrough finally came. Hoeneß’ decision to deploy Prömel as an attacker paid off in the 42nd minute. A lightning-quick attacking charge involving Jamie Leweling and Demirovic unleashed Prömel on the right. The Stuttgart native intelligently dribbled toward the net and supplied a technically beautiful finish over Atubolu from a tight angle. To their immense credit, the guests punched back hard to ensure that their strong half would not go unrewarded. Chaïbi earned a corner off a strong free-kick take at 45+1. A bit of pinball off the ensuing corner ended with Undav deflecting a Knauff volley into the Stuttgart net. The goal was credited to Knauff. A 1-1 halftime scoreline felt totally appropriate. item.title: Michigan State injury report: Spartans get back 5 starters vs. Rutgers
item.description: PISCATAWAY, N.J. — Michigan State's final availability report of the season yielded some positive breaks on the injury front. Backup quarterback Cam Fancher is one of six questionable players cleared to play against Rutgers on Saturday, Nov. 28 at SHI Stadium. Defensive linemen Eli Coenen and Ben Roberts, nickelback Michael Richard, and wide receiver Rodney Bullard Jr. were also cleared. Michigan State (3-8, 1-7 Big Ten) enters the game as a 3½-point favorite versus Rutgers (3-8, 2-6), which upset Penn State last week. This will be the final game of the season for both teams, as both are bowl ineligible and at the bottom of the Big Ten standings. Tight end Brennan Parachek was also cleared off MSU's injury report but walked around warmups in New Jersey wearing his white jersey instead of his warmup gear, a sign that he will not play. The biggest question is at quarterback, where Fancher was a game-time decision last week but looked visibly hobbled by the right knee injury he played through the week prior in a 21-14 loss to Washington . With starter Alessio Milivojevic done for the year, true freshman Kayd Coffman made his second start of the season and looked primed to make his third before Fancher's injury progress. On the defensive line, both of MSU's starters in Coenen and Roberts were listed questionable, Roberts having missed the Oregon game after aggravating a knee injury in the loss to Washington. Roberts looked to be full go in warmups, stretching with his team at SHI Stadium. To back up injury report, DL Ben Roberts looks to be full go for MSU. Remarkable considering his injury. Tough dude! @detroitnews pic.twitter.com/ql02OAilo8 — Connor Earegood (@ConnorEaregood) November 28, 2026 Michigan State will be down 12 players as ruled out earlier this week, nine of whom started at least one game this season. They include Milivojevic, linebackers Brady Pretzlaff and Jordan Hall, safety Devin Vaught, tight end Jayden Savoury, left guard Conner Moore and cornerback Tyran Chappell, as well as running backs Cam Edwards and Marvis Parrish. cearegood@detroitnews.com @ConnorEaregood This article originally appeared on The Detroit News: Michigan State injury report: Spartans get back 5 starters vs. Rutgers

item.title: 90% of Browns fans think Cleveland is beating Las Vegas tomorrow
item.description: It’s time for another week of Browns reacts results! The Browns were on the bye this past week, were promoted to Sunday Night Football, and saw all three of their AFC North foes lose (although the Steelers also won this past Friday after a chaotic few days in the headlines). Week-to-week, fan confidence decreased by 6 percentage points down to 82%. I wouldn’t read too much into the decline from 88%; overall, it basically maintained the optimistic perspective. By comparison, 92% of Raiders fans are confident in the direction of their team. That’s a really high amount that I can only assume is elevated by the team having a decent start, coupled with the excitement of getting to see their first overall pick in action now. Browns fans: Make your pick in the SB Nation app! Take Reacts surveys, create Browns polls, and see how your answers compare with fellow Dawgs By Nature fans. Then discuss the results with the Dawg Pound. Download the SB Nation app on iOS or Android . Besides the confidence meter, the main question we asked this week was what fans think the outcome of this Sunday’s Raiders vs. Browns game will be. An astounding 90% of fans think the Browns will win the game, which might be the most lopsided margin I’ve seen since running these types of polls. Fans might be feeling good like I was about Cleveland’s chances, but we just have to hope that weather doesn’t tip the X-Factor toward Las Vegas’ favor . Breaking that percentage down further, 64% of overall fans think the Browns will win a close game, while 26% think Cleveland will win big. The remaining 10% of fans voted for a Raiders victory. Here’s what one optimistic Browns fan said in regards to his vote: I believe they get an early lead and then pressure the heck out of Mendoza the rest of the game. The Browns made great strides last game with ZERO pre-snap penalties. They need to sustain that while also getting a fast start , especially on offense. The Raiders give up a lot of points, so they’re ripe for getting beat badly IF (not the capitals) the Browns can get off to a fast start. Another fan praised the Raiders for starting their rookie quarterback, but still sees a Cleveland victory: I think the Raiders are moving ahead while putting the rookie in. It was a good move for them. I think it will be another tight Browns win 27-24. According to FanDuel , the Browns are 4.5 point favorites against the Raiders this week, with the over/under being 39.5.

item.title: Adebule To Be Buried Sunday As Lagos APC Suspends Campaign Activities
item.description: The remains of former Lagos State Deputy Governor and Senator representing Lagos West, Idiat Oluranti Adebule, will be buried on Sunday, November 29, at the Ebony Vaults and Gardens, Ikoyi, Lagos. Adebule died on Saturday in Lagos at the age of 56, following a brief illness, barely a day after celebrating her birthday. The Lagos State chapter of the All Progressives Congress (APC) announced her burial date in a statement issued on Saturday by its spokesperson, Seye Oladejo. According to the statement, the burial will take place at 3 p.m., with party leaders, elected representatives, stakeholders, members and supporters expected to attend. The APC flag The party described Adebule’s death as a painful loss, saying her contributions to public service and the development of Lagos State would remain indelible. Meanwhile, the Director-General of the Lagos State APC PBAT/KOH Campaign Council, Musiliu Obanikoro, has announced the suspension of all campaign activities until further notice in honour of the deceased senator. The party said the decision was taken to reflect the grief within its ranks and accord Adebule the dignity befitting her contributions to public service. It urged all campaign structures, directorates, committees, supporters and stakeholders to comply with the directive. Tributes Senate President Godswill Akpabio and President Bola Tinubu. Her death has attracted tributes from President Bola Tinubu, Senate President Godswill Akpabio and Lagos State Deputy Governor Kadri Hamzat, among other political leaders. Tinubu expressed shock and sadness over her death in a statement issued by his Special Adviser on Information and Strategy, Bayo Onanuga. The President described her passing as a painful loss to Lagos State, the National Assembly and the country, recalling her contributions to governance, education and public administration. Similarly, Akpabio described Adebule as a treasured colleague and accomplished administrator. In a condolence message issued through his Special Adviser on Media and Publicity, Eseme Eyiboh, he said, “It is with a heavy heart and an overwhelming sense of grief that I received the devastating news of the passing of our distinguished colleague, Senator Idiat Oluranti Adebule.” File photo of Lagos State Deputy Governor, Dr Obafemi Hamzat. Hamzat also described the late senator as a dedicated public servant and accomplished educationist. “I am deeply saddened by the passing of my sister and predecessor in office, Senator Idiat Oluranti Adebule. She served Lagos State with distinction as Deputy Governor and continued that service with commitment as Senator representing Lagos West,” he said. He added that she was “a woman of peace, integrity and compassion, who touched many lives through education and public service.” Senator Idiat Adebule died in Lagos a day after her 56th birthday Adebule was born on November 27, 1970, in Ojo, Lagos State. She obtained a bachelor’s degree in Islamic Education from Lagos State Univer

item.title: NPFL : Shooting Stars hit with N5m fine, banned from home stadium
item.description: By Enitan Abdultawab The Nigeria Premier Football League has fined Shooting Stars Sports Club N5m and ordered the team to relocate its home matches to Owerri indefinitely following crowd trouble after their encounter with Rivers United in Ibadan. The league announced the sanctions in a statement published on its official website on Saturday, November 28, 2026, following Friday’s incident at the Lekan Salami Stadium. According to the NPFL, the Ibadan based club failed to provide adequate security, resulting in the compromise of the safety of the visiting team, match officials and other participants. The league also accused Shooting Stars supporters of encroaching into restricted areas and onto the field of play before holding the referees and Rivers United contingent hostage for 35 minutes after the match. It further alleged that some supporters attempted to assault the match officials and members of the visiting team. Consequently, the NPFL ordered Shooting Stars to play their home fixtures at the Dan Anyiam Stadium in Owerri, Imo State, indefinitely, while the Lekan Salami Stadium will no longer host the club’s league matches. The N5m fine was imposed for repeated failure to provide adequate security, encroachment onto the pitch, attempted assault on match officials and holding the referees and visiting team hostage after the encounter. In another development, the league recommended that the referees who officiated the match be delisted from the competition. The NPFL explained that the contents of the match officials’ report indicated that they were not assaulted, a situation which left the league body handicapped in its handling of the incident. The governing body also warned Shooting Stars and other clubs against attacking, harassing or obstructing crew members of its broadcast partner, stressing that such conduct would attract stiff sanctions. The disciplinary measures followed Friday’s encounter between Shooting Stars and Rivers United at the Lekan Salami Stadium, which ended in a draw. item.title: Birdbuddy’s latest smart feeders are still at their low Black Friday prices
item.description: The Birdbuddy Nook, ready to spot some birds. | Photo: Jennifer Pattison Tuohy / The Verge If you’ve been wondering which winged visitors have been frequenting your backyard, wonder no more as Birdbuddy’s entire lineup of smart feeders is discounted for Black Friday — including the recently released Nook and Home models. You have a few options to choose from, but our favorite, the Birdbuddy Nook , is on sale directly from Birdbuddy for $84.50 (about $85 off). The solar panel-equipped version is also down to $119 ($70 off), while the upgraded Birdbuddy Home — featuring a larger seed hopper, two solar panels, and support for 5GHz Wi-Fi — is going for $199 ($100 off). Birdbuddy Nook The Birdbuddy Nook is the company’s least expensive and smallest model, and it packs a lot of bang for your buck. Its 4K HDR camera delivers excellent image quality, and a 3.8-cup seed capacity means less frequent refills. An optional solar panel extends the already good battery life. Read our review . Where to Buy: $169 $84.5 at Birdbuddy (non-solar) $189 $119 at Birdbuddy (solar) Birdbuddy Home The Birdbuddy Home has the same 4K HDR camera as the Nook, a larger 6.4-cup seed capacity, and support for both 2.4GHz and 5GHz Wi-Fi. Where to Buy: $299 $199 at Birdbuddy If you’re curious about the differences between the available options, my colleague Jennifer Pattison Tuohy compared both the Nook and Home to the older Pro Solar . She felt like the cameras weren’t as crisp on the newer models, and the viewing angle is narrower overall. The benefit to that compromise is that the cameras can now rotate 90 degrees, letting you capture birds as they fly and approach the feeder rather than only watching them chow down. While both newer models are below the retail price of the older Pro Solar, that model is currently on sale on Amazon for $179.99 ($119 off), nearly matching its lowest price to date and making it an appealing option if you’re considering the Home. No matter which model you choose, you’ll need a paid membership to unlock all of Birdbuddy’s features, which include automatic photo and sound identification ( free users can manually request identification ), the ability to name birds yourself, and 2K ultra-resolution video. Individual plans start at $69.99 per year, while $98.99 per year grants family and friends access to livestreams and interaction; both the Nook and Home also include one free month of the Premium Family membership.
